levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the three portfolio pieces is missing.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three pieces are present and consistent with earlier lessons.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All three pieces are present, consistent, and read as a coherent single portfolio rather than three disconnected fragments.

criteria.dimension: Local rule research accuracy and sourcing

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No source is named, or a rule from an unrelated location is used without acknowledgment.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Records the minimum working age and names a current source.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Records working age, permit requirement, and hour limits, all with a named current source.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection is generic ('it was good practice') with no specific comparison or confidence statement.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Compares the warm-up guess to the research finding specifically.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names a specific portfolio piece with a genuine reason for the confidence level stated.

lookFors: The portfolio pieces are recognizably drawn from the learner's own earlier work this unit, not newly invented.
The named source for local rules is specific enough that someone else could check the same thing.
The reflection ties the guess-versus-finding comparison to a specific number or fact, not a vague impression.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
